story.summaryEn:
Race week looks good around here.
An evening with local communities in Austin, bringing people together through F1, creativity and conversation.
Austin, thank you for letting us into your world. #USGP
detailZh:
赛车周在这里看起来很棒。
在奥斯汀与当地社区共度一个夜晚，通过一级方程式赛车、创造力和对话将人们聚集在一起。
奥斯汀，感谢你让我们进入你的世界。#美国大奖赛
detailEn:
Race week looks good around here.
An evening with local communities in Austin, bringing people together through F1, creativity and conversation.
Austin, thank you for letting us into your world. #USGP
